scope: All 50 indexes on the 19 application-owned public/private tables other than settlement_transactions and data_kiosk_transactions. Managed Supabase schemas excluded.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX data_kiosk_acquisitions_pkey ON private.data_kiosk_acquisitions USING btree (id)
indexes.reason: Independent source-observation identity, FK target and provenance/manifest lookup.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX data_kiosk_acquisitions_seller_namespace_amazon_scope_root__key ON private.data_kiosk_acquisitions USING btree (seller_namespace, amazon_scope, root_query_id)
indexes.reason: Required idempotency/identity uniqueness for a seller/scope/root query; backs the publication conflict lookup.

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX data_kiosk_days_current_version_idx ON private.data_kiosk_days USING btree (current_version_id) WHERE (current_version_id IS NOT NULL)
indexes.reason: Supports current-version membership, member header visibility and protection against pruning selected evidence.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX data_kiosk_days_pkey ON private.data_kiosk_days USING btree (id)
indexes.reason: Stable day identity, version FK target and publication/retention/payout lock target.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX data_kiosk_days_seller_namespace_marketplace_name_activity__key ON private.data_kiosk_days USING btree (seller_namespace, marketplace_name, activity_date, dataset_key)
indexes.reason: Required day natural-key uniqueness; supports seller/market/date coverage, current-version capture, and exact day publication lookups.

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX data_kiosk_batches_acquisition_idx ON private.data_kiosk_preprocess_batches USING btree (acquisition_id)
indexes.reason: Real reverse acquisition-to-batch path for compatible latest versions and observation retention. The measured compatible-version plan actively used it.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX data_kiosk_preprocess_batches_pkey ON private.data_kiosk_preprocess_batches USING btree (id)
indexes.reason: Immutable preprocessing-batch identity, version FK target and provenance join.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX data_kiosk_preprocess_versions_batch_id_day_id_key ON private.data_kiosk_preprocess_versions USING btree (batch_id, day_id)
indexes.reason: Required uniqueness of each day within a batch. Its leading batch key also serves batch inventory counts, FK reverse lookup and latest-compatible-version joins.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX data_kiosk_preprocess_versions_day_id_id_key ON private.data_kiosk_preprocess_versions USING btree (day_id, id)
indexes.reason: Required composite FK target binds selected and payout versions to their day; the day-leading key also serves observation/history lookup.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX data_kiosk_preprocess_versions_pkey ON private.data_kiosk_preprocess_versions USING btree (id)
indexes.reason: Immutable version identity and fact/pruning-marker FK target; supports selected versions and payout/source validation.

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX data_kiosk_versions_batch_idx ON private.data_kiosk_preprocess_versions USING btree (batch_id)
indexes.reason: Logically prefix-redundant with UNIQUE(batch_id, day_id). At 100,000 versions the unique index handled all measured batch lookups after removal; saves 761,856 bytes. Server time for 100 lookups rose from 0.889 to 1.135 ms, a small absolute cost. No result, constraint or access change.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX data_kiosk_pruned_versions_pkey ON private.data_kiosk_pruned_versions USING btree (version_id)
indexes.reason: One immutable pruning marker per version; direct existence checks prevent publication/reuse or payout selection of pruned evidence.

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX payout_data_kiosk_version_idx ON private.payout_report_data_kiosk_versions USING btree (version_id)
indexes.reason: Active private.prune_data_kiosk_versions and prune/pin insertion guards probe version_id. Pins protect even empty Data Kiosk days and versions whose components were excluded.
indexes.evidence_basis: Maintained callers, schema constraints/triggers, and isolated synthetic benchmark; not live scan counters (payout seed tables are empty).

indexes.reason: No maintained terms-version reverse pin reader. All current manifests are report-led, and terms parents are immutable. Keep unique(report_id,terms_version_id), which is an actual component FK target.
indexes.evidence_basis: Maintained callers, schema constraints/triggers, and isolated synthetic benchmark; not live scan counters (payout seed tables are empty).

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX settlement_acquisition_document_idx ON private.settlement_acquisitions USING btree (seller_namespace, amazon_scope, report_document_id)
indexes.reason: Find prior observations of the same seller/scope/document and reject changed decoded bytes. Must remain nonunique because successful repeated downloads are retained.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX settlement_acquisitions_pkey ON private.settlement_acquisitions USING btree (id)
indexes.reason: Immutable acquisition identity, FK target and direct offline manifest lookup.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX settlement_preprocess_versions_pkey ON private.settlement_preprocess_versions USING btree (id)
indexes.reason: Immutable version identity and fact FK target; supports selected-version metadata, payout manifests, and current-pointer resolution.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX settlement_preprocess_versions_settlement_id_id_key ON private.settlement_preprocess_versions USING btree (settlement_id, id)
indexes.reason: Required composite FK target proves a selected/payout version belongs to the specified Settlement; also supports parent-scoped version access.

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX settlement_versions_acquisition_idx ON private.settlement_preprocess_versions USING btree (acquisition_id)
indexes.reason: No maintained reverse-acquisition reader exists: offline preprocessing loads acquisitions by their PK and publishes new versions. Parent acquisition UPDATE/DELETE is rejected by a BEFORE immutable trigger before a legitimate reverse FK check can run. Keep the FK and all constraints. Test-only acquisition-filtered assertions do not justify a production index.

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX settlements_current_version_idx ON private.settlements USING btree (current_version_id) WHERE (current_version_id IS NOT NULL)
indexes.reason: Current-version membership and reverse source lookup used by live reads and the member visibility helper; not redundant with the natural key or PK.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX settlements_pkey ON private.settlements USING btree (id)
indexes.reason: Stable Settlement identity, version FK target, publication locks and source selection.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX settlements_seller_namespace_amazon_scope_settlement_id_key ON private.settlements USING btree (seller_namespace, amazon_scope, settlement_id)
indexes.reason: Required source natural-key uniqueness and exact publication conflict lookup; leading seller/scope also supports capturing current versions.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspace_revision_tokens_pkey ON private.workspace_revision_tokens USING btree (source, scope_company_id)
indexes.reason: Required one token per source/company scope; exactly matches polling join and ON CONFLICT upsert. No caller filters revision/changed_in; adding indexes there would increase every token update cost.

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX app_accounts_company_idx ON public.app_accounts USING btree (company_id)
indexes.reason: Nonconstraint company lookup/FK support. Current ownership authorization joins accounts to terms on company_id. Not redundant with user_id PK; previously observed in current-company-source-version helper plans.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX app_accounts_pkey ON public.app_accounts USING btree (user_id)
indexes.reason: One application grant per Auth identity; exact user_id lookup on every workspace/access check; Auth deletion cascade uses the same key.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX companies_pkey ON public.companies USING btree (id)
indexes.reason: Company identity and referenced company FKs; company lookup uses this ID. No secondary name/order index is justified for the current tiny lookup.

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX payout_components_period_idx ON public.company_payout_report_components USING btree (fee_period_id)
indexes.reason: No maintained period-only component reader. Fee-period parent is immutable; normal insertion validates the parent unique pair. Report-scoped component reads remain indexed by unique(report_id,row_number).
indexes.evidence_basis: Maintained callers, schema constraints/triggers, and isolated synthetic benchmark; not live scan counters (payout seed tables are empty).

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX payout_components_sku_idx ON public.company_payout_report_components USING btree (seller_sku_id)
indexes.reason: No maintained SKU-only component reader. There is no direct seller_sku_id-only component FK; composite terms FK targets immutable parent. Existing report-leading constraints cover actual reads.
indexes.evidence_basis: Maintained callers, schema constraints/triggers, and isolated synthetic benchmark; not live scan counters (payout seed tables are empty).

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX payout_components_terms_idx ON public.company_payout_report_components USING btree (terms_version_id)
indexes.reason: No maintained independent terms-only component reader. Immutable terms and report-term parents reject update/delete before reverse FK checks; publication validates references through parent unique indexes. Report-scoped child reads use existing constraint indexes.
indexes.evidence_basis: Maintained callers, schema constraints/triggers, and isolated synthetic benchmark; not live scan counters (payout seed tables are empty).

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX company_payout_reports_company_date_idx ON public.company_payout_reports USING btree (company_id, start_date, end_date)
indexes.reason: No maintained caller filters payout reports by company/start/end. Keep company-leading lookup for legitimate mutable-company parent FK checks; add global(created_at DESC NULLS LAST,id ASC) matching operator REST default.
indexes.evidence_basis: Maintained callers, schema constraints/triggers, and isolated synthetic benchmark; not live scan counters (payout seed tables are empty).

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX seller_skus_pkey ON public.seller_skus USING btree (id)
indexes.reason: Stable SKU identity; terms selection and current-fee reads locate exactly one seller_sku_id. Also adequately narrows the child side of composite current-terms FK because id is unique.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX seller_skus_seller_namespace_sku_key ON public.seller_skus USING btree (seller_namespace, sku)
indexes.reason: Required identity uniqueness and ON CONFLICT arbiter for publication; separates equal SKU text across sellers; supports source ownership mapping.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sku_fee_periods_pkey ON public.sku_fee_periods USING btree (id)
indexes.reason: Required globally unique fee-period identity used by API rows and immutable report evidence; retain the existing primary-key guarantee.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sku_fee_periods_terms_version_id_id_key ON public.sku_fee_periods USING btree (terms_version_id, id)
indexes.reason: Required referenced composite key binds report fee evidence to its terms revision. Its leading terms_version_id also supports complete-inventory counts and current-fee expansion.

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX sku_fee_periods_terms_version_id_marketplace_name_valid_pe_excl ON public.sku_fee_periods USING gist (terms_version_id, marketplace_name, valid_period)
indexes.reason: Required GiST exclusion index prevents overlapping fee periods for one terms version/marketplace. Also offers date containment lookup; read-plan nonuse on 192 rows is not grounds to drop this integrity index.

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX sku_terms_versions_company_idx ON public.sku_terms_versions USING btree (company_id)
indexes.reason: Nonconstraint company lookup/FK support; company-to-owned-SKU authorization/selection needs this path. Old revisions are filtered by current pointer; extra current_terms index is not justified by this seed.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sku_terms_versions_pkey ON public.sku_terms_versions USING btree (id)
indexes.reason: Immutable terms-version identity; current/explicit-version reads and revision tracking use exact old/new version IDs.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sku_terms_versions_seller_sku_id_id_key ON public.sku_terms_versions USING btree (seller_sku_id, id)
indexes.reason: Required referenced composite key for current-term pointer and frozen payout manifests/components; guarantees the selected revision belongs to the same SKU, despite globally unique id.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sku_terms_versions_seller_sku_id_version_number_key ON public.sku_terms_versions USING btree (seller_sku_id, version_number)
indexes.reason: Required per-SKU revision-number uniqueness. Publisher computes MAX(version_number) within one seller_sku_id; this key also supports that history access.

added_indexes.name: company_payout_reports_created_idx
added_indexes.purpose: Actual unfiltered operator REST default ordering with stable ascending id ties.

added_indexes.name: company_payout_reports_company_idx
added_indexes.purpose: Mutable company parent FK lookup. Existing date tails lack an active caller.

access_additional_indexes_not_justified: companies(name,id): existing administrative lookup sorts two companies and is cached; no demonstrated scale problem.
app_accounts(created_at,user_id): would target large admin user directories, not the hot exact-user authorization/polling path.
seller_skus(current_terms_version_id): existing identity PK plus version PK/composite FK already locate one current record; no measured missing path.

sku_fee_periods(terms_version_id,marketplace_name,valid_period,id): complete current-term fee sets are already reached by a mandatory leading-terms B-tree; few periods per current term do not justify another ordering index.
workspace_revision_tokens(revision) or (changed_in): never queried as filters; would add update/WAL cost and hinder HOT updates.
metadata_latest_observation_assessment: No new time suffix is justified by maintained callers. Latest independent observations are ordered by acquisition.root_query_created_at and acquisition.id after day→version→batch joins; an acquisition-created index alone cannot supply this day-scoped order. Existing indexes measured compatible lookup at~0.036ms server and complete three-observation comparison~2ms even for the busiest day. Global retention ranks all metadata and needs a separate query/workflow review if it becomes expensive.
payout_limitations: Synthetic distribution; no claim that all optional reverse indexes can be omitted from a different future application with mutable parent records or new reverse readers.
